DIAGNOSIS READY: Vestibular Neuritis with associated sensorineural hearing loss (suggesting Labyrinthitis).

The neurological exam shows nystagmus and unstable gait, but the brain MRI is clear, which makes a central stroke or multiple sclerosis unlikely. The presence of bilateral decreased hearing alongside your severe vertigo suggests inflammation of the inner ear rather than a nerve isolated to the vestibular system. Do you have any history of recent viral infections or does the dizziness worsen when you turn your head quickly?
